name: deepseek
description: DeepSeek provider module: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions model routing across the deepseek-chat (flash-class) and deepseek-reasoner (pro-class) tiers with cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions chat with Bearer auth and typed output validation.
LOW/MED route to deepseek-chat, HIGH/MAX to deepseek-reasoner, chosen from the issue-#9 tier ladder.
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `deepseek` provider adapter. Pattern only; the OpenAI-compatible provider-gateway shape and the DeepSeek capability/tier vocabulary were re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
